description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointment Mr. B. R. Pushpakumara as Secretary to the State Ministry of Foreign Employment Promotions and Market Diversification
categorisation: This gazette content specifically announces the appointment of a named individual (Mr. M. B. R. Pushpakumara) to a government position (Secretary to the State Ministry of Foreign Employment Promotion and Market Diversification). It does not include any detailed description of the portfolio responsibilities or subject matter duties of the position, which is the key requirement for a Hybrid (Type 3) classification. Therefore, it fits the criteria for a People Gazette (Type 2).
